# and_intro
### `and_intro : P -> Q -> P ∧ Q`
`and_intro` is a function with two parameters. It takes two disparate pieces of evidence and combines them into a single piece of evidence. If `(e₁ : P)` and `(e₂ : Q)` are evidence, then
```
have h : P ∧ Q := and_intro e₁ e₂
```
